Additionally, the MMONiCo + Ce material showed high 
stability, achieving elevated CO2 conversion (~85 %) even after 1400

MMONiCo + Ce (168 mol CH4 h−1 L−1)
Remarkably MMONiCo + Ce remained more stable than MMONiCo with no significant changes in catalytic activity (~85 % of CO2 conversion after 1400 min of continuous use).

steps.details: Nitrates metallics such as Mg(NO3)2, Al(NO3)3, and Ni(NO3)2.6H2O were added gradually to sodium carbonate solution at 65 ◦C, stirred for 1 h and crystallized for 4 h.
The resultant solid was washed until neutral pH
Nitrates metallics such as Mg(NO3)2, Al(NO3)3, Co(NO3)2.6H2O, and Ni(NO3)2.6H2O were added gradually to sodium carbonate solution at 65 ◦C, stirred for 1 h and crystallized for 4 h.
The resultant solid was washed until neutral pH
Reconstruction methodology: A fixed amount of Ce(NO3)3.6H2O was complexed with EDTA solution at pH 10. The MMO from the HT was added to the solution and vigorously stirred for 24 h.
